# Pocket Advisor

> Pocket Advisor is an offline-first personal spending and budget application for Android and a free web budget & calculator suite. Features automated on-device bank & UPI SMS transaction tracking under Google Play financial rules, 2-stage greedy debt minimization bill splitting, interactive wealth planners, and 100% private SQLCipher encrypted local storage.

## Web Budget & Calculator Tools

- [Quick Bill Splitter](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/split): Free web bill splitter using a 2-stage greedy bipartite debt minimization algorithm. Collapses tangled group expenses into minimum bilateral payments with 1-tap WhatsApp summary export and zero login required.
- [Flatmates Rent & Utility Splitter](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/flatmates-rent-splitter): Split roommate rent, maid, WiFi, and electricity with 1-tap UPI deep links.
- [Home Loan Prepayment vs SIP Calculator](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/home-loan-prepayment-vs-sip): Compare home loan interest saved against compounding equity SIP wealth.
- [SIP Wealth Planner](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/sip-calculator): Compounding investment calculator supporting annual step-up contributions and real purchasing power discounting based on historical inflation rates.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/emi-calculator): Reducing-balance loan installment and amortization schedule planner for home, car, and personal loans in India.
- [All Calculators](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/calculators): Interactive suite of financial decision calculators.

## Mobile Application (Android)

- [Download Pocket Advisor](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/download): Official Android app on Google Play. 100% offline-first tracking for UPI and banking expenses.
- [Features & Architecture](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/features): Technical overview of on-device bank & UPI SMS transaction detection (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, Bandhan, etc.), SQLCipher encrypted local database, and interactive widgets.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/faq): Common queries on security, privacy, bank auto-detection, debt algorithms, and the fair freemium monetization model.

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/privacy): Complete transparency on data collection. 100% on-device data processing guarantee with zero server tracking of SMS, OTPs, or notifications.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/terms): Application usage terms and service policies.
- [Cancellation & Refund Policy](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/refund): Policy on Google Play Billing subscriptions and cancellation terms.
- [Account & Data Deletion](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/delete-account): Self-service compliance portal to purge cloud backup data.
- [Contact & Customer Support](https://www.pocketadvisor.in/contact): Direct email support, bug reporting, feature suggestions, and developer inquiries.
